title: Build grading table result display on submission status page (status-testcases.html)
acceptance_criteria: For short-answer and fill-blank submissions, below the existing test case summary icons, a grading table is rendered showing per-sub-question results

Table columns: Sub-question Label, Raw Score, Calibrated Score, Max Score, Status (AC/WA badge), Feedback (from SubmissionTestCase.feedback), Reasoning (from SubmissionTestCase.extended_feedback, shown in expandable detail)
Each row shows the strictness preset that was applied (Strict/Normal/Lenient) as a small colored badge/pill
The grading table is NOT shown for code/MCQ submissions (only for short-answer and fill-blank types)
Reasoning text is shown in a collapsible row (using the existing .case-feedback .toggled pattern from the template — click chevron to expand)
Row status uses existing case-AC / case-WA CSS classes for color coding
Total row at bottom sums calibrated scores and max scores across all sub-questions
Styling consistent with existing submissions-status-table classes
Works when grading_table was None (old single-case format): shows the single test case row normally without the grading table breakdown
